title: A Variational Latent Equilibrium for Learning in Neuronal Circuits
abstract: arXiv:2603.09600v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Brains remain unrivaled in their ability to recognize and generate complex spatiotemporal patterns. While AI is able to reproduce some of these capabilities, deep learning algorithms remain largely at odds with our current understanding of brain circuitry and dynamics. This is prominently the case for backpropagation through time (BPTT), the go-to algorithm for learning complex temporal dependencies. In this work we propose a general formalism to approximate BPTT in a controlled, biologically plausible manner. Our approach builds on, unifies and extends several previous approaches to local, time-continuous, phase-free spatiotemporal credit assignment based on principles of energy conservation and extremal action. Our starting point is a prospective energy function of neuronal states, from which we calculate real-time error dynamics for time-continuous neuronal networks. translated_title: 神经回路学习中的变分潜在平衡
translated_abstract: 大脑在识别和生成复杂时空模式方面的能力仍然无与伦比。尽管人工智能能够复现其中部分能力，但深度学习算法在很大程度上与我们目前对大脑回路及其动力学的理解相悖。随时间反向传播（BPTT）——学习复杂时间依赖性的首选算法——便是其中的典型例子。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个通用形式化框架，以可控且生物学上合理的方式来近似BPTT。我们的方法基于、统一并扩展了此前多种基于能量守恒和极值作用量原理的局部、时间连续、无相位（phase-free）的时空信用分配方法。我们的出发点是神经元状态的前瞻性能量函数，由此计算时间连续神经网络的实时误差动力学。基于此，作为第一个贡献，我们提供了一个简单且……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于神经元状态前瞻性能量函数的通用形式化框架，以可控且生物学合理的方式统一并扩展了多种局部时空信用分配方法，从而实现对随时间反向传播（BPTT）的近似，用于学习复杂时间依赖性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a general formalism, built on a prospective energy function of neuronal states, that approximates backpropagation through time (BPTT) in a controlled, biologically plausible manner while unifying and extending previous local, time-continuous, phase-free spatiotemporal credit assignment approaches.
